work.title: Symphony No. 7 in E major
work.movement: II. Adagio — Sehr feierlich und sehr langsam

version.note: Neither the Commons page, the IMSLP performance entry nor the embedded tags names the edition performed (Gutmann 1885, Haas, Nowak or Cohrs). The 1885 first edition is cited only as a viewable public-domain score for the orchestration timeline. Whether the cymbal-and-triangle clash at the climax is played is not established by the audio analysis.

performers.note: The IMSLP performance entry gives “Hochschulsymphonieorchester (Munich), Marcus Bosch (conductor)” and the MP3’s embedded artist tag reads “Hochschulsymphonieorchester (München), Ltg. Marcus Bosch”. The Commons page credits only “University of Music and Theatre Munich” as author. No roster of players is given.

date.note: IMSLP (“Live recording at the University of Music and Theatre Munich 2020”), the embedded date tag and Commons all give the year 2020. The IMSLP file names carry the token 2021-11-08, which is not decoded as a session date, and no day or month of the concert is stated.

place.value: University of Music and Theatre Munich (Hochschule für Musik und Theater München); the hall is not named
place.note: IMSLP’s miscellaneous note and the embedded comment (“Live-Konzertmitschnitt der Hochschule für Musik und Theater München 2020”) name the institution as the place of the live recording, not a hall or street address.

label.value: University of Music and Theatre Munich (IMSLP publisher information); no commercial label
label.note: IMSLP’s publisher field reads “University of Music and Theatre Munich, 2020”. The file is a concert recording distributed through IMSLP and Wikimedia Commons, not a label release.

catalogue.value: IMSLP recording #899191; file PMLP7929-2021-11-08 HP8 HSO Bruckner-7 02.mp3
catalogue.note: This is IMSLP’s own identifier for the file, not a label catalogue number.

matrixTakeSides.note: A 2020 live concert capture distributed as an MP3 file has no disc matrix, take or side. This is not a statement about the unrecorded original recording medium.

credits.note: IMSLP names the uploader of the file (Musikisum, 11 February 2024) and the Commons file page lists the University as author; neither identifies a recording, editing or mastering engineer. An uploader is not treated as a transfer engineer.

date.note: The IMSLP upload date (11 February 2024) and the Commons revision dates are not transfer or session dates.

processing.value: MP3 file, about 128 kbit/s, 1075.652 s, with embedded ID3 tags; hosted unchanged on Wikimedia Commons as an MP3 original.
processing.note: The bit rate and tags were read from the cached copy with ffprobe; the Commons media record gives the duration and MP3 type. No restoration, editing or loudness processing is disclosed.

digital.format: MP3 original file hosted by Wikimedia Commons

composition.value: Public domain; Commons tags the composition PD-old-auto-expired (Bruckner died in 1896).
composition.note: The notice concerns the composition only. It does not license a modern critical edition or this recording.

recording.value: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International. Rights rule 1: the licence covers the sound recording.
recording.note: The Commons Copyright information template gives recording = CC BY-SA 4.0, the IMSLP performance entry states Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, and the embedded copyright tag reads CC BY-SA 4.0. The licence is that of the University of Music and Theatre Munich’s recording; it is separate from the composition’s public-domain tag.
